featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Khire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely unprofessional behavior. They don’t pick up calls during normal business hours and claim they are out of town and only available via text, yet reply on Sunday saying it’s their holiday. They quoted Rs. 12L for a 3-day event including photography and a wedding film, but when I asked what the videography actually includes (short reel, documentary, trailer, etc.), the only response was, “Yes, videography is included.” That level of communication is unacceptable for a service at this price point.

When I raised concerns, they asked for my email to send details even though a PDF could easily be shared on WhatsApp. Only after I said I cannot manage such important discussions over text did they agree to a phone call, and even then the tone felt like they were doing me a favor while on holiday. If you’re on holiday, don’t respond. I’ve dealt with far more reputed and well-known vendors who communicate far more professionally.

featured_reviews.name: Atisha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Vilas Bangar
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit to Kaasa Studio for an actor look test for my upcoming film left me thoroughly impressed. From the moment I stepped in, the studio’s professional yet welcoming ambiance set the tone for a productive session. The space is thoughtfully designed, blending functionality with creativity, making it an ideal choice for both photography and film-related projects.
What stood out most was the studio’s exceptional range of amenities. They offer a variety of backdrops—from minimalist solid colors to textured setups—that cater to diverse creative needs. The lighting setup is top-tier, with high-quality flashes and softboxes that allowed us to experiment with different moods and tones effortlessly. The inclusion of a spacious green screen area was a huge plus, especially for a project like ours that requires post-production flexibility. Every piece of equipment felt meticulously maintained and up-to-date, reflecting their commitment to quality.
The studio’s layout is spacious and well-organized, ensuring smooth movement for the team and actors. Natural light from large windows complemented the artificial setups, giving us additional versatility during the test. The staff were equally commendable—polite, attentive, and always ready to assist without intruding on the creative process. Their professionalism made the entire experience hassle-free. What truly elevated the session was how these resources translated into results. The look test outcomes were crisp, vibrant, and precisely aligned with our vision, thanks to the studio’s reliable infrastructure. Whether you’re a filmmaker, photographer, or content creator, Kaasa Studio provides a seamless environment to bring ideas to life.  In a city where finding a studio that balances quality, space, and affordability can be challenging, Kaasa Studio stands out as a gem. I left feeling confident about the project and will undoubtedly return for future needs. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a stress-free, well-equipped creative space!
